title: Top 3 Agent Architectures 2024
content: Everyone is moving from ReAct to state-machine driven agents. ReAct gets stuck in loops too easily.

title: Why my Multi-Agent system failed
content: Agents talking to each other directly is a mess. Need an environment or shared blackboard for them to communicate indirectly.

title: LLM Eval Metrics Trend
content: Stop using simple string match. LLM-as-a-judge is the new standard, but you need to calibrate the judge.
